cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.
